hooks.command: PAYLOAD=$(cat); WORKSPACE=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/workspace.py"); [ -n "$WORKSPACE" ] || exit 0; SID=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/check-gate.sh" --enforce-output --session "${SID:-}" --workspace "$WORKSPACE"

PAYLOAD=$(cat); WORKSPACE=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/workspace.py"); [ -n "$WORKSPACE" ] || exit 0; FILE_PATH=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ] && exit 0; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/check-gate.sh" --check-path "$FILE_PATH" --workspace "$WORKSPACE"

PAYLOAD=$(cat); WORKSPACE=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/workspace.py"); [ -n "$WORKSPACE" ] || exit 0; SID=$(printf '%s' "$PAYLOAD" | jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/check-gate.sh" --count-agent-spawn --session "${SID:-unknown}" --workspace "$WORKSPACE"
